critical_code_review_comments: MyWallet.jsx L80: subtitle has `whitespace-nowrap`. On mobile the subtitles (多種支付 · 即時入帳 / 充值 · 付款 · 明細) fit exactly inside the 58% left-column (pr-[42%]) at 10px font — if the strings are ever lengthened or system font metrics differ, nowrap could push the text under the illustration. Consider removing whitespace-nowrap or allowing 2-line clamp on mobile.

MyWallet.jsx L87-88: wallet-last-tx uses pt-11 on mobile to make room for the absolute tag. The tag is 32px tall and uses rounded-br-xl, so its lower-right curve sits just above the TxRow icon — visually clean here, but if a longer tag label were used it could visually crowd the row. Acceptable as-is.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all visual acceptance checks pass on both viewports

Last-tx: on mobile uses pt-11 + absolute corner tag (rounded-tl-2xl rounded-br-xl bg-slate-800); on desktop tag goes static inline. pb-20 on inner wrapper creates clearance so floating service-widget-trigger (fixed bottom-20 right-4 h-14 w-14 = y=714..770 on 400x850) does not cover the last-tx amount.
